(빈 슬라이드)

Received Power • Recall that the radiation field at point P by an accelerated charge is E(x,t) = (q/c)[ n̂×{(n̂−β)×β̇} / (κ³R) ]_ret, B(x,t) = [n̂×E]_ret, where n̂ ≡ R(t′)/R(t′), β ≡ v(t′)/c, κ ≡ 1 − n̂·β. [그림: 원점 O에서 전하 위치 x₀(t′)로의 벡터, 궤적 곡선 위 속도 v(t′), 관측점 P까지의 벡터 x와 R = x − x₀(t′)]

• The power pattern received by an observer at P is dP/dΩ = R²(S·n̂) = (q²/4πc)[ |n̂×{(n̂−β)×β̇}|² / κ⁶ ]_ret – Depends on both β and β̇. – The κ term is responsible for the beaming effect of emitted radiation.

dt/dt′ • The received power is determined by the acceleration of a charge at the retarded time t′ = t − R(t′)/c. • Since R²(t′) = |x − x(t′)|², 2R dR/dt′ = 2[x − x(t′)]·(−v) = −2R n̂·v ⟹ dR/dt′ = −n̂·v, we obtain 1 = dt/dt′ − (1/c)dR(t′)/dt′ = dt/dt′ + n̂·β ⟹ dt/dt′ = 1 − n̂·β = κ

• Geometrical interpretation: – Consider a situation that a moving source emits radiation as it moves from point 1 to point 2 at velocity v over the time span dt′. – The difference in arrival times dt of the radiation emitted at 1 and 2 is equal to dt′ minus the time taken for radiation to propagate a distance d = v dt′ cosθ: dt = dt′(1 − (v/c)cosθ) = κ dt′ [그림: 점 1에서 2로 v dt′ 이동, 각 θ 방향으로 나가는 두 광선, 1에서 나간 광선이 c dt′ 진행, 그 중 v dt′ cosθ 부분 표시]

Emitted Power • For relativistic charges, there is a difference between the emitted and received power. • Since the energy flux received by an observer between t₁ = T₁ + R(T₁)/c and t₂ = T₂ + R(T₂)/c is ∫_{T₁+R(T₁)/c}^{T₂+R(T₂)/c} [S·n̂]_ret dt = ∫_{T₁}^{T₂} (S·n̂)(dt/dt′) dt′, the energy flux emitted is given by S·n̂ (dt/dt′) = κ S·n̂ (evaluated at t′) • Therefore, the emitted power per unit solid angle is dP_em/dΩ = R²(S·n̂)(dt/dt′) = (q²/4πc)|n̂×{(n̂−β)×β̇}|²/κ⁵ evaluated at t′ – Different from dP/dΩ by a factor of κ = 1 − n̂·β = 1 − βcosθ.

When β ∥ β̇ [dP_em/dΩ = (q²/4πc)|n̂×{(n̂−β)×β̇}|²/κ⁵] • If β ∥ β̇, n̂×{(n̂−β)×β̇} = n̂×(n̂×β̇) so that dP_em/dΩ = (q²/4πc) β̇² sin²θ/(1−βcosθ)⁵ = (q²/4πc³) a² sin²θ/(1−βcosθ)⁵ where a = cβ̇. θ: angle between β and n̂ • If non-relativistic (β≪1), dP_em/dΩ = (q²/4πc³) a² sin²θ : dipole radiation [그림: β̇∥β 수직 화살표와 n̂ 사이 각 θ; 3D 도넛형 쌍극자 파워 패턴]

When β ∥ β̇ • If relativistic (β→1), we use the Lorentz factor γ² = 1/(1−β²) to approximate 1 − βcosθ ≈ 1 − (1 − 1/2γ²)(1 − θ²/2) ≈ (1+γ²θ²)/(2γ²) • Then, the angular distribution of the emitted power is dP_em/dΩ ≈ 8q²a²γ⁸(γθ)²/(πc³(1+γ²θ²)⁵) : peaks at γθ_max = 1/2. [그림: 가로축 γθ(0–2), 세로축 정규화된 dP_em/dΩ — 0에서 0, γθ≈0.5에서 최대 1, 2 근처에서 0으로] Beaming effect [그림: 속도 v 방향(위)으로 쏠린 두 개의 좁은 로브(β≈1)와 원래의 작은 쌍극자(β≪1), 각 θ_max 표시]

When β ∥ β̇ • The total emitted power is P_em = ∫(dP_em/dΩ)dΩ = (q²a²/4πc³)2π∫₀^π sin³θ/(1−βcosθ)⁵ dθ = (q²a²/2c³)∫_{−1}^{1}(1−μ²)/(1−βμ)⁵ dμ = (q²a²/2c³)·4/(3(1−β²)³) = 2q²a²γ⁶/(3c³) ∝ γ⁶ • This recovers the Larmor formula for non-relativistic (γ=1) dipole radiation.

When β ⊥ β̇ • Let us take β and β̇ parallel to the z- and x-axes, respectively. • Set n̂ = (sinθcosφ, sinθsinφ, cosθ). Then, n̂ − β = (sinθcosφ, sinθsinφ, cosθ − β). (n̂−β)×β̇ = det[x̂ ŷ ẑ; sinθcosφ sinθsinφ cosθ−β; β̇ 0 0] = β̇(0, cosθ−β, −sinθsinφ) n̂×{(n̂−β)×β̇} = β̇ det[x̂ ŷ ẑ; sinθcosφ sinθsinφ cosθ; 0 cosθ−β −sinθsinφ] = x̂β̇(−sin²θsin²φ − cos²θ + βcosθ) + ŷβ̇ sin²θ sinφ cosφ + ẑβ̇ sinθcosφ(cosθ−β) = x̂β̇(−1 + sin²θcos²φ + βcosθ) + ŷβ̇ sin²θ sinφcosφ + ẑβ̇ sinθcosφ(cosθ−β) [그림: β∥ẑ, β̇∥x̂, 관측 방향 n̂의 극각 θ·방위각 φ]

When β ⊥ β̇ • Then, |n̂×{(n̂−β)×β̇}|² = β̇²(−1 + sin²θcos²φ + βcosθ)² + a² sin⁴θ sin²φ cos²φ + a² sin²θcos²φ(cos²θ − 2βcosθ + β²) • By collecting terms containing cos²φ separately, one can write |n̂×{(n̂−β)×β̇}|² = β̇²(1−βcosθ)² + β̇² cos²φ sin²θ(β²−1) = β̇²(1−βcosθ)² − β̇² cos²φ sin²θ/γ² • Therefore, the angular distribution of the emitted power is dP_em/dΩ = (q²/4πc)|n̂×{(n̂−β)×β̇}|²/κ⁵ = (q²a²/4πc³)(1/(1−βcosθ)³)[1 − sin²θcos²φ/(γ²(1−βcosθ)²)], β̇ = a/c
note: 슬라이드 첫 식 둘째·셋째 항의 a²는 β̇²(차원상 동일 의미, a=cβ̇)로 읽어야 함.

raw: When β ⊥ β̇ • For γ ≫ 1, 1 − βcosθ ≈ 1 − (1 − 1/2γ²)(1 − θ²/2) ≈ (1+γ²θ²)/(2γ²) so that dP_em/dΩ ≈ (2q²a²γ⁶/(πc³(1+γ²θ²)³))[1 − 4γ²θ²cos²φ/(1+γ²θ²)²] ➔ Most energy is concentrated in a small angle with θ ≤ 1/γ. [그림: 3D 회색 타원체 파워 패턴(β, β̇ 축 표시); φ=π/2 평면 단면 — 가속도 a 방향의 작은 로브와 속도 v 방향으로 길게 뻗은 로브, 반각 1/γ 표시; 오른쪽 dP_em/dΩ vs γθ(0–2) 그래프, 0에서 최대 후 γθ≈1–2에서 0으로 감소] at the φ = π/2 plane

When β ⊥ β̇ • The total emitted power is P_em = ∫(dP_em/dΩ)dΩ = (q²a²/4πc³)[2π∫₀^π sinθdθ/(1−βcosθ)³ − (1/γ²)∫₀^π sin³θdθ/(1−βcosθ)⁵ ∫₀^{2π}cos²φdφ] = (q²a²/4πc³)[2π·2/(1−β²)² − (1/γ²)·4/(3(1−β²)³)·π] = (q²a²/4πc³)·8πγ⁴/3 = 2q²a²γ⁴/(3c³) ∝ γ⁴ • Again, this recovers the Larmor formula for non-relativistic (γ=1) dipole radiation.

General Cases • In general, the acceleration a of a charge can be decomposed into the parallel component a∥ and the perpendicular component a⊥ to its velocity: – a = a∥ + a⊥ and a² = a∥² + a⊥² • The total power can then be written as P_em = (2q²γ⁴/3c³)(a⊥² + γ²a∥²) = (2q²γ⁶/3c³)(a⊥²/γ² + a∥²) = (2q²γ⁶/3c³)(a⊥²/γ² + a² − a⊥²) = (2q²γ⁶/3c³)(a² − β²a⊥²) = (2q²γ⁶/3c)[β̇² − (β×β̇)²] valid for general β̇ and β. where we used a = β̇c, a⊥ = |(β/β)×β̇|c
